subtitles.en: Steven from the market perspective, how does the end of Iran's oil wave change the outlook?
subtitles.zh: 从市场角度看，伊朗石油浪潮的结束如何改变前景？

subtitles.en: You know, I think it creates a complicated matter because a lot of that oil was being sold potentially at a deep discount to secure customers. A lot of the actually buyers in Asia were already
subtitles.zh: 我认为这造成了复杂局面，因为很多石油可能以大幅折扣出售以吸引客户。许多亚洲买家已经

subtitles.en: had replaced their flows from the Persian Gulf. And so you were seeing this sort of flood of Iranian vessels coming in. It was kind of pushing prices down further. And with the
subtitles.zh: 替换了来自波斯湾的供应。大量伊朗油轮涌入，进一步压低了价格。随着

subtitles.en: sanction waivers, it meant essentially anyone could buy that oil. Now, removing that, of course, it doesn't change the global supply demand balance to too much. Iran is basically, it was
subtitles.zh: 制裁豁免，基本上任何人都可以购买这些石油。现在取消豁免，并不会太大改变全球供需平衡。伊朗的

subtitles.en: exporting about one or two percent of global oil supply. But now, with that off the table, it does tighten things a bit. It doesn't change the fact that the market is facing. At least in
subtitles.zh: 出口量约占全球供应的1%到2%。但如今这部分消失，确实让市场略微收紧。但这并未改变市场面临的情况，至少

subtitles.en: the short term, a bit of an oversupply, as I mentioned, a lot of the buyers, whether they're India, Japan, or China to a degree, had found replacements or figured out ways to not use oil
subtitles.zh: 短期来看，市场仍有些供应过剩。正如我所说，许多买家，包括印度、日本，甚至中国，已经找到了替代品或设法减少石油使用。

subtitles.en: at all in China's sake. I mean, they reduced their imports quite significantly over the last few months. So the market is already kind of frothy. Removing the Iranian barrels doesn't mean that
subtitles.zh: 以中国为例，过去几个月进口量大幅下降。市场已经有些泡沫。移除伊朗的石油并不意味着

subtitles.en: suddenly that there's a shortage. In fact, it was really just icing on the cake. So potentially,
subtitles.zh: 突然出现短缺。事实上，这不过是锦上添花。所以，可能
